description: A pill navigation bar whose active pill breaks into gooey droplets when you pick any item, flies over to the new item, and merges back into one piece.
interactionNotes: Tap any item and the active pill breaks into tiny droplets, crosses the bar, and gathers again on the new item. As the pointer passes, a soft halo lights up behind the item under it. The bar works with the keyboard too: each item is a real link or button with a focus ring. If you do not pass `href`, the item becomes a button and only calls `onChange`.

props.items: The items. Each item has a `label` and optionally `href` and `icon`; without `href` it renders as a button.
props.activeIndex: Controlled state; pass it with `onChange` to keep control of the selection yourself.
props.onChange: On every selection, returns the index and the item itself.
props.theme: Theme of the frame and text; the pill color is derived from its own luminance.
props.color: Color of the active pill. Pass a hex or `rgb()`; the text color inside is chosen automatically.
props.activeTextColor: Text color inside the pill. Omit it to have it derived from the luminance of `color`.
props.colors: Color of the droplets; they blend when they meet. Empty means the pill color itself.
props.size: Size of the pill and the type.
props.frame: The frosted glass frame around the bar.
props.animationTime: Roughly how long the droplets take to reach the new item, milliseconds.
props.particleCount: How many droplets the active pill breaks into on each selection.
props.spread: How far the droplets spread along the path, pixels.
props.timeVariance: Random difference in each droplet's timing, milliseconds.
props.gooeyness: How readily droplets and pills merge, 0 to 1.
props.wobble: How much the new pill wobbles while forming, 0 to 1.
props.hoverEffect: Soft halo behind the item under the pointer.
props.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the bar for screen readers.
props.autoPreview: Site preview only: it advances the active item itself. Keep it off in normal use.
props.className: Extra class for the bar's root.
props.style: Inline style; it sits after the color variables.

tips: Give the labels Persian text and keep them short; the bar wraps with `flex-wrap`, but a single line is always more readable.
If the items have real destinations, pass `href`; without it they become buttons and you handle navigation yourself in `onChange`.
Pass `colors` for the droplets so you see several close hues when it breaks; leave it empty to keep the pill color.
The active pill uses the luminance of `color` to choose white or dark text; if you pass a very light or very dark color and dislike the result, set `activeTextColor` explicitly.
On touch devices `hoverEffect` has no effect; the halo only appears with a real pointer.
The droplet motion is turned off under `prefers-reduced-motion` and the selection lands directly — value and accessibility stay untouched.
